text:
Unfortunately, repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days is listed as not covered by the Plant Care Guarantee, so a claim for this drooping would most likely not be approved. Since you repotted on day 6, that falls inside the 14-day window.

A Plant Care Specialist can give you free advice on helping the ZZ recover (for example, how to handle the soil or watering), by chat or email. If you'd like, I can also escalate this to a Support Lead to review your situation.
